title: Finite integral-system expressions with retained origins and intermediate bounds
statement: For the coefficient systems and operation package [def-sf-integral-system-operations], define finite typed expressions over a scheme with variable, inverse-image, proper direct-image, quasi-compact open-extension, tensor and chosen compact-support constructors [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. The integral interpretation uses the recorded completed pullback and tensor [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], ordinary proper direct image and localized open extension. Its domain consists of derived-complete constructible integral inputs [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] whose reduced inputs and every intermediate system are normalized [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], constructible with common finite cohomological and Tor intervals [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], and have bounded-below etale origins [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness] tied to their evaluated fibers and compatible with the actual coefficient transitions. The compact-support constructor checks its hidden open-extension intermediate as well as its proper-image output. Retain the full input-family functors and their reduction and total-limit realizations.

source.place: The expression-tree domain, recursive admissibility, and common boundedness/origin proviso used by the realization recursion.
